note: Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon: residence as a non-citizen is France's; foreigners make their residence applications on France's online service for foreigners (ANEF, the Ministry of the Interior's), and the prefecture handles France's titles there (long-stay visa validation, EU citizens, the resident card, the long-term resident EU card, the Algerian residence certificate). Read on the prefecture's own page (saint-pierre-et-miquelon.gouv.fr) on 2026-10-30. A provisional work authorisation in the archipelago lasts at most 9 months, renewable (the work engine's).
